label: Chapter 27
english: When we are oppressed by the demon of listlessness, then with tears let us divide our soul in two, one part encouraging the other, sowing good hopes within us, soothing with David’s chant, ‘Why are you downcast, my soul, why do you trouble me? Hope in God, for I will confess him, the Savior of my countenance and my God’ (Ps. 41:6).
